recognize_zh: A 圖腦脊髓液中見一團核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質布滿透明空泡的母細胞樣細胞（白血病侵犯腦膜）；B 圖則以分葉核嗜中性球為主並夾雜泡沫狀巨噬細胞，符合藥物引起的無菌性腦膜炎反應。
features: Panel A: cluster of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio and molded round-to-indented nuclei
Panel A: fine chromatin and abundant, sharply punched-out clear cytoplasmic vacuoles at the cell periphery
Panel B: mixed cellularity dominated by segmented neutrophils
Panel B: vacuolated macrophages/monocytes and scattered red cells; no vacuolated blast clusters
No microorganisms visible in either panel
describe_en: Two cytospin preparations of cerebrospinal fluid are shown. Panel A shows a cohesive-appearing cluster of immature mononuclear cells with high N:C ratios, fine chromatin and prominent peripheral cytoplasmic vacuoles, consistent with CSF involvement by the patient's known lymphoblastic leukemia. Panel B shows a neutrophil-predominant pleocytosis with admixed vacuolated macrophages and red cells, without an evident blast population or organisms. In the clinical setting, panel B supports a drug-induced aseptic meningitis superimposed on prior meningeal leukemia; microbiologic cultures are required to exclude infection.

ddx.vs: Also neutrophil-predominant, but shows organisms on Gram stain/culture with low glucose, whereas drug-induced aseptic meningitis is culture-negative.
Macrophages have lower N:C ratio, reniform nuclei, abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and phagocytosed debris, unlike the high N:C blasts of panel A.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles and a mature B (CD10+, TdT-negative, sIg+) phenotype, versus TdT+ Ph-positive B-lymphoblasts.
Peripheral blood contamination yields leukocytes proportional to red cells, not a disproportionate neutrophilic pleocytosis.
